name: Tobias Ahlin Bjerrome

scale_evidence.figure: NO public MAU figure for GitHub Copilot exists. Best available figures are cumulative/all-time users, not MAU: 'over 26 million users' (Microsoft FY2026 Q1 earnings call, Oct 29 2025, Nadella prepared remarks — official transcript); '20 million all-time users' (TechCrunch, 2025-07-30, explicitly all-time/cumulative). The only MAU figure Microsoft discloses is '150 million monthly active users' for the combined first-party Copilot family (information work, coding, security, science, health, consumer) — NOT GitHub Copilot specifically. Microsoft/GitHub disclose 'users' (cumulative), never GitHub Copilot MAU.
